newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Zeus rises 14.02 pct on cement firm talk.
newsitem.headline: Zeus rises 14.02 pct on cement firm talk.

text.p: The Philippines' Zeus Holdings Inc rose by 30 centavos, or 14.02 percent, to 2.44 pesos by late Monday trade in Manila, brokers said.
"People are still buying it up on report that a cement company is buying into the company," Allan Araullo of Regina Capital Development Corp said.
Zeus used to be a garment company, but had recently decided to convert into a holding company.
Zeus officials were not immediately available for comment.
